english.note: Use this for the ironic quality or significance of a situation rather than an individual remark.

examples.english: He took every safety precaution, yet ended up falling at home; the situation is full of irony.
examples.traditional: 佢做足安全措施，最後反而喺屋企跌親，件事好有諷刺意味。
